Subject: CPPO flow — commission split & billing question

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the call earlier — Karen and I pulled together our commercial ask so we can finalize the Private Offer paperwork with AWS. Two quick items we need clarity on before we route the PO on our side:

1) Commission split: ResellCo normally takes a 15% commission on list price for Marketplace-resold SaaS. For CPPO we need to understand how Redwood will report and remit that — do you invoice ResellCo and reimburse via a credit, or does AWS handle the payout?

2) Billing entity & invoice timing: ResellCo will submit a PO to Redwood once the CPPO is live. We need confirmation of the billing entity name, VAT handling (we operate in US/EU), and whether Redwood can issue consolidated monthly invoices showing line items per account.

I attached our preferred commission schedule and an example PO template (commission_schedule_v1.xlsx). Can you review and confirm next steps?

Target timeline: if we can confirm commercial mechanics this week, ResellCo can route a signed PO next Tue and we can kick off the CPPO activation.

Thanks,
Paul Garcia

ResellCo

Paul — thanks for the clear note and the schedule. Looping Ben and Karthik to confirm the CPPO mechanics from Sales & Channel ops.

Short answers up front:
- Commission payout: Redwood will reconcile bookings and issue a monthly partner invoice (credit) to ResellCo for the agreed commission percentage. We do not rely on AWS to remit partner commissions for CPPOs; Redwood handles partner payouts directly.
- Billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (EIN: XX-XXXXXXX). We can issue consolidated monthly invoices with line items by end-customer. For EU VAT we will need ResellCo's VAT registration numbers for each billing entity.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben to confirm payout cadence and required invoice paperwork.
2) I will attach a draft CPPO (private offer) ready for your review and include a suggested commission matrix matched to your schedule for parity.
3) ResellCo to share sample signed PO once you confirm VAT entity mapping.

Attached: draft_cp_po_resellco.pdf (Draft private offer) — please review the pricing rows and let us know if you want the reseller margin applied as a line-level discount or as a separate revenue share.

Grace/Paul — quick follow up from channel ops side. I ran the numbers with finance — here's the recommended flow that minimizes accounting friction and works with AWS CPPO constraints: 

- Setup: Redwood will be the Marketplace seller of record for the CPPO (standard). ResellCo will be listed as the reseller in the private offer metadata.
- Deal execution: ResellCo submits the customer PO to Redwood (copy to AWS PP support if required). Redwood accepts the PO, activates CPPO in AWS, and invoices the end-customer per Redwood's billing cadence.
- Commission reconciliation: Redwood will calculate partner commissions monthly and issue a single net payout to ResellCo the following month (30-day payout). For clarity, Redwood will send an itemized report for each customer included in the payout.
- Commission mechanics: We support two options — (A) discount-first: Redwood shows list price in the CPPO and offers a line-level discount equivalent to ResellCo margin (this yields clean AWS reporting), or (B) revenue-share: Redwood invoices the customer at net price and then issues a separate commission payout to ResellCo. Option A is simpler for AWS invoicing and recommended unless ResellCo prefers explicit revenue-share accounting.

Required for activation:
- ResellCo billing entity name(s) + VAT numbers (EU)
- ResellCo legal name & W-9 or equivalent for US entities (for vendor onboarding)
- Signed PO (scan or PDF)

I created a DocuSign powerform for the reseller agreement appendix (commission appendix) — link below. If ResellCo signs that and sends PO, we can aim to activate CPPO within 72 hours.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123

Grace — I left the commission matrix column comments in the attached draft (same PDF). Paul — happy to jump on a 20-min call today if you want to iron out the discount-vs-payout approach.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Channel Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachment: draft_cp_po_resellco.pdf (updated with margin comments)

Ben/Grace — thanks for the clear path. We reviewed Option A (line-level discount) and prefer that because it simplifies our downstream accounting and AWS reporting. A few confirmations from our side: 

- ResellCo will provide VAT numbers for EU customers and a scanned PO for the first deal (attached). Please confirm the billing entity name to put on the PO — we'll use the Redwood info you supplied (Redwood Inference, Inc.).
- We'll sign the DocuSign commission appendix today (link received).
- Can Redwood include the following fields on the invoice line item so our systems can automatically match payouts: ResellCo Partner ID, CPPO ID, End-customer account alias.

Attached: ResellCo_PO_4247.pdf (Purchase order). Once you confirm the invoice field mapping and the payout cadence (30-day), we'll route the PO.
